display_name: Fixed source validation of learned blind channel correction
description: Evaluate source-trained correction on fixed previously explored, disjoint impaired source records; no DURA or target.

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Fixed source IQ, independent posterior initial state and three alternative three-step paths
data.tx_sets_ref: No source true identity labels, simulated channel truth, U_s truth, V or test in this validation; clean-F pseudo labels only

permissions.query_use: Received source and blind parent to infer g; paired clean source IQ only for diagnostic evaluation and oracle comparator; no TX labels, U_s truth, V or ground test.
permissions.claim_scope: Source forward residual diagnostic only; predictor uses full received waveform and source records previously explored; not restoration or identification accuracy.

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen learned channel predictor, frozen source blind action and source Gaussian prior; no DURA and no F network.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Channel predictor training commit 0831bcec99be5d2e3d20aa093a674a5eed6eb68d; disjoint 8192 source fit IDs vs 2048 source validation/heldout records.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Before source training completes, fixed full waveform operator diagnostic on 1024 RX4/6 and 1024 RX8: flag promising if RX4/6 aggregate mean clean-forward residual decreases >=1%, each of six RX4/6 scene means increases <=1%, and RX8 overall mean increases <=1%; this does not establish restoration or accuracy and no test is consulted.

metric_names: source normalized forward residual using fixed blind A, learned correction, naive blind and source clean oracle
bounded correction norms and oracle coefficient prediction error
dimensions: RX4/6 source validation and RX8 source heldout, all and six scenes
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Predict g from received and blind-parent forward only, evaluate against true source clean IQ; whole waveform used for prediction, so no held-out-time guarantee. Predeclared aggregate and scene guards; no TX or target.

rows.purpose: evaluate whether supervised source-only channel prediction improves forward model over fixed blind action
rows.seed_notes: Prior model seed 2026125054; fixed final epoch8; no source validation training.
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: Registered while 8192-record source training was running; no learned-model validation or ground results available.
Predictor input is received and blind parent only; clean source IQ is evaluation and oracle comparator only.
Source observations were explored before, full waveform used for prediction; source forward residual is not TX identification accuracy.
Model is only an operator correction, not yet a deployable standalone waveform restoration; a new end-to-end restoration requires separate fixed evaluation.
